description: The Original Oyster House seafood restaurant first opened its doors in Gulf Shores in 1983. Our restaurant on the Causeway, overlooking Mobile Bay, opened in 1985. Since then we have proudly served the Gulf Coast the best seafood in a casual atmosphere with genuine southern hospitality. Known for hand-shucked and fire-grilled oysters, homemade gumbo, cheesy grits with blackened shrimp, fresh salad bar and handcrafted desserts including famous peanut butter chocolate chip pie.

specials.description: Meet me at the Mobile Causeway Original Oyster House for the best happy hour! Great specials include $5 Bloody Marys, $5 Margaritas, $5 local craft beers, $5 well drinks, $5 house wines and $7 & $10 appetizers.

specials.description: Sweetheart Special package for $32.99 per person, not including tax and tip. Start with award-winning seafood gumbo, followed by Create-Your-Own-Seafood Platter with choice of three items, served with two famous sides. Finish with homemade bourbon bread pudding to share.

private_event_spaces.name: Banquet Room
private_event_spaces.description: 2,000 square foot space surrounded by the Mobile Delta with panoramic views of Mobile's skyline. Fully equipped with podium, AV and screen, private bathrooms. Perfect for corporate meetings, receptions, bridal rehearsal dinners, retirement or birthday parties, presentations and celebrations.

private_event_spaces.name: Chart Room
private_event_spaces.description: Small, intimate private dining room with rustic tone and clean lines. Features 48-inch flat screen TV for presentations. Good for board meetings, sales presentations, small rehearsal dinners.

private_event_spaces.name: Delta Room
private_event_spaces.description: Private dining room with old world, vintage tone. Features memorabilia on walls and sea turtle window graphics. Well-suited for business meetings and birthday celebrations.

private_event_spaces.name: Lighthouse Room
private_event_spaces.description: Private dining room for small to medium business meetings or private parties. Rustic tone with clean lines. Features 48-inch flat screen TV for presentations. Available in off-peak seasons.

private_event_spaces.name: Pelican's Landing
private_event_spaces.description: Semi-private dining room with casual seating and stunning waterfront view. Comfortably accommodates groups. Available in off-peak seasons. Perfect for family gatherings and office parties.

special_programs.name: Chelsea Garvin Spirit Award Scholarship
special_programs.description: Annual $1,000 scholarship awarded to a Baldwin County high school senior. Created in 2006 in memory of Chelsea Garvin. Requirements: high school senior in Baldwin County with minimum 2.5 GPA, participated in school or community art event, submit artwork reflecting Original Oyster House brand.

special_programs.name: Sustainable Energy/Oyster Shell Recycling
special_programs.description: First restaurant in Alabama to recycle oyster shells through Alabama Coastal Foundation. One of only restaurants to grow stocker oysters for reef restoration.
